valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E: FY2027 adjusted diluted EPS viewed at the 12-month target date (Nov 2027), times a justified P/E. USD listing (NYSE), no ADR conversion. Anchor: FY2026 adjusted diluted EPS guidance tightened to $5.50-$5.55 (midpoint $5.525) in the Oct 21, 2026 Q3 release, with Q4 guided to $1.62-$1.67; adjusted figures exclude the about $670M pre-tax NEC/Gill specified item, so the GAAP Q3 EPS of $0.53 is not used. Management gave no FY2027 outlook in the release, so FY2027 EPS is my assumption, set near the +9.2% adjusted Q3 EPS growth rate. Share count 1,738M diluted in Q3 2026.

bear.driver: Medical Devices and Diagnostics growth slows toward the ~6% full-year comparable sales outlook, with Electrophysiology and Diabetes Care headwinds (cited in secondary Q3 coverage) persisting; EPS barely grows and the multiple de-rates.

base.driver: Medical Devices ($5,826M, +7.8% comparable in Q3), Diagnostics ($3,305M, +6.4% comparable) and Established Pharmaceuticals (+8.4% comparable) keep growing, and Nutrition (+4.9%) holds; adjusted EPS grows about 9.5% on the FY2026 midpoint, in line with the Q3 adjusted EPS growth of 9.2%.

bull.driver: Medical Devices and Diagnostics re-accelerate, with Exact Sciences contributing as expected and fewer specified charges, lifting EPS about 16%; the stock re-rates toward the upper end of its own range.

valuation.implied_by_close: At base EPS of $6.05 the $108.52 close implies 17.9x FY2027 (19.6x the $5.525 FY2026 guidance midpoint). The aggregate mean target of $118.91 (26 analysts, Yahoo Finance aggregate, not used in the base case) implies about 19.7x base EPS, or $6.26 of EPS at 19x.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $6.05 (about 5.6% of the close); $0.10 of FY2027 EPS moves it by about $1.90 at 19x.
valuation.watch_metric: Comparable sales growth in Medical Devices and Diagnostics (Q3: +7.8% and +6.4%) and whether FY2027 adjusted EPS tracks toward $6.05 without further specified charges.
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4 and full-year 2026 results, the first point at which Abbott is expected to give FY2027 framing; the release date is not sourced in this research.

analyst_notes: After the Oct 21 Q3 beat and tightened guidance, the Oct 22 named notes were mixed: Wells Fargo (112 to 119), Baird (121 to 123) raised targets, while TD Cowen (135 to 118), JPMorgan (120 to 118), BTIG (134 to 125), RBC (130 to 125) and Citi (125 to 122) cut. Named targets now sit at $118 to $127, 9% to 17% above the close and mostly above the $115 base case; the $3 to $12 gap above the $114.95 base is about $0.16 to $0.63 of FY2027 EPS at 19x, or a higher multiple, and none of these notes state their assumptions. No named call documents a 12-month horizon, so none enters a weighted target, and the unnamed Bank of America $125 (Nov 10) and the Barclays Miksic rows are excluded because their dates and authors could not be reconciled across sources.
